description: Cartoon illustration of the Pepe the Frog character drawn as a green aerial bomb falling nose-down through a blue sky with clouds. The bomb body bears the label 'MOAB' (Massive Ordnance Air Blast, colloquially 'Mother of All Bombs'), with tail fins at top and a yellow nose cone; Pepe's smirking face and a hand form the midsection.
flags: Pepe the Frog is a meme character that has been used in some contexts as a hate symbol; here it appears as a generic chan-culture mascot

description: Screenshot of a Q post (tripcode !UW.yye1fxo, dated 01/27/18, No.70) rendered on a lavender background. The post addresses '@Snowden', asks 'How's Russia?', and references John Perry Barlow, Freedom of the Press Foundation, and SecureDrop, insinuating a link between SecureDrop and 'Clowns In America' (Q-lexicon for the CIA). These are the drop's claims, not established facts.
text: Q !UW.yye1fxo 01/27/18 (Sat) 12:09:33 No.70. @Snowden. The clock is ticking. How's Russia? [Mr. Contractor] Freedom of the Press. John Perry Barlow. https://freedom.press. SecureDrop [Whistleblowers]? SecureDrop>Clowns In America. NOBODY IS SAFE. Q
flags: The drop's insinuation linking SecureDrop to the CIA is an unverified claim
